domain: Echelon 3 / World vegetation residency and flow-field async execution
summary: Normal ClearAllResidency no longer force-drains in-flight vegetation jobs. It cancels pending chunk, threat, flow, thermal, and abyssal path work and lets LateFrame dispatcher completion release native payloads.

git_diff_check_warnings: LF will be replaced by CRLF for touched files

fixes_this_pass.issue: ClearAllResidency is reached from normal RefreshResidency when tile state or player context disappears, but it still called DisposeAllChunkBuildJobs and could force-complete chunk jobs outside teardown.
fixes_this_pass.fix: Added Cancelled flags to host pending structs, added HasActiveChunkBuildJobs, CancelAllChunkBuildJobs, and CancelAsyncWorldJobsForResidencyClear; ClearAllResidency now marks async work canceled and returns cleanup to LateFrame fences.

fixes_this_pass.issue: Threat, flow, and thermal jobs could publish stale output after a full residency clear because they lacked a cancellation bit.
fixes_this_pass.fix: Added CancelVegetationSimulationJobsForResidencyClear and pending.Cancelled checks before every DataVault publish path.

fixes_this_pass.issue: Static source contract did not prove normal residency clear avoids forced chunk drains.
fixes_this_pass.fix: Added source-contract assertions for cancel route and cancel-before-publish ordering.

finally_release_proof: TryCopyVegetationMemorySnapshot releases vault write lock in finally
TryPublishRadarPendingJob releases each acquired GPR write lock in finally
Cancelled threat/flow/thermal jobs return before TryCopyVegetationMemorySnapshot and still release pending NativeArrays in finally

continuous_scalability.cinematic_cheat_position: Cancellation keeps old visual snapshots instead of blocking for physical correctness. Grass, abyssal paths, flow visuals, and GPR density remain continuous quality-budgeted visual systems, not new gameplay truth simulation.

unmanaged_layout.note: Added Cancelled bools only to host-side pending structs carrying NativeArray and JobHandle fields. No Burst job payload DTO and no [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)] unmanaged offsets were changed.

residual_risks: dotnet build was not executed because CPU was 65 percent and dotnet PID 1604 was active.
No Unity profiler microsecond measurement was taken; microsecond claims remain static estimates only.
